states.name: Lutrinox
states.title: Lutrinox
states.description: Lutri travel in swarms, feeding primarily on birds, such as ignigeons. When the birds migrate in winter, they ravage the land looking for a different kind of prey.

states.name: Lutrimax
states.title: Lutrimax
states.description: Evolved Lutri build complex wood and rock structures atop waterfalls. Wealthy eccentrics have hired mercenaries to empty these out to use as mansions.
